news.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after initially rejecting his return
news.description: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as chair, CEO, and director five days after rejecting his return. The independent investigation is continuing, while Nvidia shares rebounded sharply after the announcement.

news.title: OpenAI deploys GPT-6.2 Sol in ChatGPT’s Chat tab
news.description: OpenAI is adding a chat-optimized version of GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT’s Chat tab. Sol and Astra are also available in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API; OpenAI says Sol delivers performance close to Astra’s at about one-fifth the cost.

news.title: OpenAI proposes common limits for AI pretraining
news.description: OpenAI published internal perplexity scores and proposed common limits among labs while safety-monitoring systems catch up with model advances.

news.title: Virginia and Oregon sue Elon Musk’s companies
news.description: Virginia and Oregon have filed lawsuits against Elon Musk’s companies, alleging that Grok lacked adequate safeguards against child sexual abuse material and non-consensual intimate images. These are allegations, not judicial findings.

news.title: Shirudo, OpenAI and Cisco’s open-source tool, protects Linux servers
news.description: Shirudo is a free, open-source tool that protects a Linux server against a known exploit until the permanent patch is installed, without a reboot. Operators must approve each protection.

news.title: Sierra raises $1.75 billion at a $30 billion valuation
news.description: Startup Sierra raised $1.75 billion, doubling its valuation in six months to reach $30 billion. It says nearly half of Fortune 50 companies are customers.

news.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to validate code changes
news.description: Claude Ship reviews code changes, fixes failed checks, and approves routine pull requests according to a natural-language policy. The tool is available for Team and Enterprise plans on GitHub, primarily in beta.

news.title: AWS launches Strands Decider v2 to rank options
news.description: Strands Decider v2 is a family of open-weight models from AWS that scores a list of options. AWS says routing between two Claude models solves 94% of tasks at 44% of the cost.

news.title: Meta’s AI chief says superintelligence is near
news.description: Alexandr Wang believes AI-assisted progress on the Riemann hypothesis shows that raw intelligence is no longer the main limiting factor. Anthropic improved a mathematical bound without solving the hypothesis, while Stanford published a draft of a human proof.

news.title: GPT-6.2 Astra produces a mathematical proof using its own strategy
news.description: OpenAI’s model independently produced a computer-verifiable proof of the Smoktunowicz gap theorem. It had to devise a proof strategy because Mathlib lacked sufficient foundations and solved 49 of 56 tasks on the Autoform-Hard leaderboard.

news.title: CrowdStrike acquires Zscaler in the largest cybersecurity deal
news.description: CrowdStrike will acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction. The combined company will cover enterprise security from devices to the cloud.

news.title: OpenAI’s AI smartphone could redefine mobile interfaces
news.description: OpenAI’s AI smartphone, reportedly to be assembled by Foxconn, would include agent-driven tasks, two NPUs, and custom hardware. Its launch is reportedly targeted for 2027-2028, raising issues around privacy, permissions, and enterprise device management.

news.title: Guide: Set up ChatGPT in five minutes
news.description: The guide explains how to enable custom instructions, provide context, and turn on memory so ChatGPT can better adapt to its user.

news.title: Create AI agents with no prior knowledge
news.description: This article explains how to build artificial intelligence agents without prior experience.

news.title: Build an AI agent in minutes with Claude
news.description: The article shows how to quickly build an artificial intelligence agent using Claude.

news.title: Create AI agents with Notion
news.description: The article explains how to create artificial intelligence agents with Notion.

news.title: Claude may have helped solve the Riemann hypothesis
news.description: The Lean and Mathlib communities indicate that the formal proof of this 167-year-old hypothesis has been verified. This breakthrough could have major implications for AI and mathematics.

news.title: Anthropic stages a record-breaking IPO
news.description: Anthropic is presented as having completed an IPO that broke all records.

news.title: Google’s quantum chip surpasses classical limits in an impossible game
news.description: The article presents results from a Google quantum chip that surpasses the limits of classical computers in a game described as “impossible.”

news.title: Ubisoft creates Motherbrain studio dedicated to AI for gameplay
news.description: Ubisoft has created the Motherbrain studio, dedicated to using artificial intelligence in gameplay.

news.title: China fears U.S. AI could expose its nuclear missiles
news.description: According to The New York Times, the Chinese military fears that U.S. artificial intelligence could expose its nuclear missiles.

news.title: Why China won the AI-generated video race
news.description: The article analyzes why China won the race to AI-generated video.

news.title: OpenAI’s prompt engineering best practices
news.description: OpenAI presents simple rules and before-and-after examples, including explaining what to do rather than merely stating what not to do.

news.title: A discussion thread examines prompt anti-patterns
news.description: An OpenAI community discussion asks whether adding many instructions can degrade responses, while participants debate the issue.

news.title: Questions about fast charging the Tesla Model Y Premium 2026
news.description: A buyer who reserved a Model Y 2026 asks which home charger to use for the fastest charging at 240 V and whether the Tesla charger has any specific features.

news.title: Tech stocks plunge after three years of gains
news.description: The three major indexes fell sharply Friday, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 5% and wiping out all its 2026 gains. Concerns about Anthropic’s IPO, tighter regulation and inflation are driving the decline, which could also represent an overdue reset.

news.title: Google envisions an AI-generated TV channel in which you are the star
news.description: A Google patent describes “My Channel,” an infinite stream of AI-generated videos tailored to the viewer’s tastes and personal information. A system could integrate ads directly into each video, but Google has not said it plans to launch the product.

news.title: Coding agents poorly reuse companies’ approved code
news.description: A DesignVerse study of 15 legacy codebases found that two coding agents used approved internal code in only 55% to 59% of tasks, compared with 92% using DesignVerse’s configuration. The results should be interpreted cautiously because the study was funded by the company and its participating organizations were not named.

news.title: Anthropic allows local storage of Mythos and Fable data
news.description: Anthropic is loosening its data-retention rules for Mythos and Fable. Business customers can now retain the required prompts and responses themselves for 30 days.

news.title: OpenRouter warns of possible third-party access to MiniMax conversations
news.description: OpenRouter warned that prompts and responses sent to MiniMax models may have been accessed by a third party, according to Axios.

news.title: Embo raises $110 million to train robotic models
news.description: Embo raised $110 million in a seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz. The company develops AI models for robots trained on videos and hands-on experience in learned world models.

news.title: Google AI Mode can now analyze your Drive and Wallet files
news.description: Google AI Mode can read Drive and Wallet files to answer requests based on the user’s data, such as creating a tax plan from their spreadsheets. Access is optional, and Wallet remains read-only.

news.title: The Gemini API now charges only for the pages or cells used
news.description: The Gemini API lets developers send only the necessary pages or cells instead of an entire file, with billing limited to that portion. It also accepts Office files directly.

news.title: Google tests semantic governance rules for AI agents
news.description: Google’s semantic governance policies check every action proposed by an AI agent against plain-language rules before execution. The feature is in preview.

news.title: Nothing Ear Note earbuds include a microphone in their case
news.description: Nothing Ear Note earbuds place a microphone in their charging case to record and transcribe conversations. They are scheduled to launch in December.

news.title: Gemini 4 agents speed up quantum algorithms by up to 290 times
news.description: Google DeepMind and Google Quantum AI used teams of Gemini 4 agents to optimize and prove quantum algorithms. Some routines are up to 290 times faster, with results verified in Lean 4 and released as open source.

news.title: GLM-5.4 uses a looped architecture to compete with larger models
news.description: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, a 750-billion-parameter model whose certain layers are executed twice on each pass. The company claims it reaches the level of models with 2 trillion to 3 trillion parameters, but the available benchmarks cover only a 30-billion-parameter test version.

news.title: Nvidia wants to make a speaking brain implant portable
news.description: A Paradromics implant allows a person with motor neuron disease to communicate using more than 400 electrodes and AI. An Nvidia Jetson module is intended to reduce the electronics to a box attached to a wheelchair within a year, and potentially later to a phone.

news.title: Meta’s open models help locate epilepsy seizures
news.description: Meta is funding teams using Muse Glimmer, SAM 3, DINOv3, and Brain2Qwertyv2, among others. In France, these models help doctors locate the source of epilepsy seizures, while a U.S. project trains healthcare workers in virtual reality.

news.title: RoboTrack evaluates tracking of objects manipulated by robots
news.description: Ai2 released a benchmark containing 307 annotated real-world videos, 15 million simulated trajectories, and two models. The results show that tracking is less reliable in the real world, but training on simulated data improves performance.

news.title: Claude Fable 5.2 costs three times more than Opus 5.5 for a similar result
news.description: In a bug-fixing test, Fable 5.2 passed 10 of 15 trials for about $89, compared with 9 of 15 for about $29 with Opus 5.5. With more budget, Opus also passed 10 trials for $33.

news.title: AI could become conscious in the next few years, philosopher says
news.description: Rob Long of Eleos AI believes AI systems could become conscious in the next few years. He highlights the dilemma between the moral risk of ignoring it and the risk of overprotecting a dangerous agent.

news.title: Thomas Nagel challenges Anthropic’s argument about AI consciousness
news.description: Philosopher Thomas Nagel called Anthropic’s argument concerning the possible consciousness of its models “ridiculous”; the issue was mentioned among risks for investors. A poll found that 33% of Americans believe AI will become conscious and 7% believe it already is.

news.title: Developer recounts how AI assistants are transforming the profession
news.description: In a personal essay published by Wired, a former philosophy student turned developer describes his relationship with code, from Java to Haskell. He reflects on a profession transformed by AI assistants.

news.title: Rock-based carbon capture could reduce crop yields
news.description: CarbonPlan studies indicate that excessive spreading of crushed rock on fields would reduce agricultural yields. The capture potential would be less than one billion tonnes of CO2 per year, compared with the hoped-for 3 billion to 8 billion tonnes.

news.title: NariQ compresses a 27-billion-parameter model into 10 GB
news.description: Nari Labs compressed Qwen3.8-27B to three bits to produce a model of about 10 GB, with no measurable quality loss in several tests. The two-bit version, however, loses significant quality and requires a modified version of llama.cpp.

news.title: Gemini can now create short animated GIFs
news.description: The Gemini app can generate short looping GIFs from a description or image using the Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash model. The feature can animate a photo or create a reaction for social media.

news.title: U.S. agencies monitored Alice Huang in the Nvidia case
news.description: The New York Times reports that U.S. agencies tracked Alice Huang’s contacts with China’s Ministry of State Security. Investigators are seeking to determine, among other things, whether Southeast Asian companies helped transfer restricted AI chips to China.

news.title: China’s military fears AI could threaten its nuclear missiles
news.description: According to The New York Times, Chinese military researchers believe AI could reduce U.S. decision time from 15 to 30 minutes to 90 seconds. An AI-generated false report had already nearly triggered a confrontation with a Chinese vessel.

news.title: AI’s energy demand revives geothermal power
news.description: Google has committed to obtaining 50 megawatts of geothermal electricity from Quaise Energy. The company must drill nearly five kilometers beneath Oregon to reach very hot rock and produce steam for turbines.

news.title: xAI rents its servers to Anthropic and Google instead of building everything itself
news.description: Since May, SpaceXSI, xAI’s parent company, has reportedly been renting computing power to its own competitors. Meanwhile, xAI is scaling back projects and dissolved the 60-person Grok Imagine team after going public.

news.title: AI-assisted attack takes European Commission systems offline
news.description: An AI-directed intrusion forced the European Commission to take its human resources and reimbursement systems offline for ten days. The attack illustrates the speed enabled by public tools such as ARTEX and the importance of defenses, segmentation, and continuity plans.

news.title: Gemini 4 Neon cuts the cost of AI-assisted coding
news.description: Google Gemini 4 Neon handles bugs spread across multiple files with a one-million-token context and four reasoning levels. The highest level increases costs by about 72% for minimal gains.

news.title: A GTA 6 Scam Kit Is Circulating for $200
news.description: Fake GTA 6 downloads for PC are linked to a $200 scam kit containing account stealers, cryptocurrency drainers, and hidden miners. The article outlines the warning signs and immediate steps to protect accounts and devices.

news.title: Nvidia’s AI Computers Could Reduce Cloud Costs
news.description: Nvidia’s RTX Spark desktop computers come with up to 128 GB of memory to run models locally and reduce recurring cloud API costs. However, their starting price of $4,499 must be weighed against the savings for each workload.

news.title: Google’s AI Mode Adds Temporary Conversation Threads
news.description: Google’s AI Mode temporary threads hide conversations from visible search history and disable personalization. However, the discussions may be retained for around two months.

news.title: Security Tests Show AI Models Classifying Civilians as Military Targets
news.description: Commercial AI models classified a real elementary school and civilians as military targets. Vals tests show that game framing and weak technical safeguards can bypass providers’ policies.

news.title: The EU Chips Act Unlocks €33 Billion in Investments
news.description: Europe has unlocked €33 billion to revive its semiconductor industry, with new factories, GaN power-production sites, and packaging and testing lines spread across more than 20 projects. Commercial production will not begin immediately, however.

news.title: Differentiation Isn’t Enough: You Need to Create Value for Customers
news.description: Being different from competitors does not mean being more useful to customers. Companies must differentiate themselves on the criteria their customers genuinely value, using tools such as the Strategy Canvas and the Value Proposition Canvas.

news.title: Automate sales prospecting
news.description: The article presents methods for automating sales prospecting.

news.title: Jensen Huang apologizes to Nvidia employees
news.description: Nvidia’s CEO returned to headquarters in Santa Clara, where employees welcomed him with cheers and chants. He apologized for the turbulence and promised to be “a better CEO the second time around.”

news.title: Jensen Huang’s victory tour revelations on CNBC
news.description: This article revisits the biggest revelations from Jensen Huang’s victory tour with Trump on CNBC.

news.title: Trump wants corporate America to remember who is in charge
news.description: The article reports that Trump wants corporate America to remember who is in charge.

news.title: Jensen Huang is worth $1 trillion to Nvidia
news.description: Jensen Huang’s value to Nvidia amounts to $1 trillion, something the board could not ignore.

news.title: Tesla says the new FSD version is 25 times safer
news.description: Tesla has begun rolling out Full Self-Driving v15 and claims the system handles critical situations 25 times better. The update notably adds a real-time view of the vehicle’s intentions, but the system remains supervised.

news.title: U.S. intelligence warns of new technology outages
news.description: U.S. intelligence director Jay Clayton warns that Americans should expect more disruptions and technology outages. The warning comes after several incidents involving system and network upgrades.

news.title: Dutch privacy authority advises against “perverse glasses”
news.description: The Dutch data protection authority is urging consumers not to buy the “perverse glasses.”

news.title: OpenRouter removes three providers after prompt theft
news.description: OpenRouter removed three providers after researchers discovered prompt theft that allegedly continued for several months at AI hosting companies.

news.title: Monetizing Google’s AI Search Is Costing Apple Revenue
news.description: The article claims that Google’s failure to monetize AI search is causing Apple to lose revenue.

news.title: Chips withstand space, but their funding is uncertain
news.description: The article examines chips’ ability to survive in the space environment and questions the viability of their funding.

news.title: Microsoft will pay Azure’s top talent more
news.description: Microsoft plans to pay its top Azure employees more and tighten its requirements for other workers.

news.title: Perplexity and intelligence
news.description: The article titled “Perplexity and Intelligence” concerns the links between Perplexity and intelligence.

news.title: Amazon signs deal for Decart’s AI technology and team
news.description: Amazon signed a deal covering Decart’s AI optimization technology and team.

news.title: Z.ai launches GLM-5.4, its first Loop Transformer model
news.description: Z.ai has launched GLM-5.4, its first model based on the Loop Transformer architecture.

news.title: AI assistant extensions pose risks to private data
news.description: An audit conducted before installation flagged potential privacy violations in approximately 55% of more than 500 marketplace skills handling personal information.

news.title: AI data center planning can cut costs by 6.5%
news.description: Planning that combines multiple chip types and different AI workloads across sites and schedules could reduce daily costs by about 6.5% while staying within local power-grid constraints.

news.title: U.S. election prediction markets slow down
news.description: Prediction markets generated $2.7 billion in transactions for this year’s U.S. elections, compared with $8.5 billion in 2024, according to an analysis by the Pew Research Center.

news.title: Shorter, consistent prompts make models more reliable
news.description: Prompts that accumulate contradictory rules give the model two commands at once. The article recommends removing contradictions and stating what the model should do instead of multiplying prohibitions.

news.title: Claude’s prompt engineering best practices
news.description: This guide presents essential techniques and common mistakes, with a section devoted to positive instructions rather than avoidance-based wording.

news.title: Google’s prompt design strategies for Gemini
news.description: Google details clear instructions, examples and constraints, as well as how to prioritize rules when they conflict.

news.title: When negative prompts are still useful
news.description: Virtualization Review explains when an instruction such as “avoid this” may still be relevant and why too many constraints produce the opposite effect.

news.title: A new Tesla owner worries about range on road trips
news.description: A new owner living in the southwestern United States is planning several Tesla trips but is concerned about Supercharger availability in some areas.

news.title: A Tesla makes an intelligent lane change earlier than expected
news.description: A driving observation reports an automated lane change approximately 100 to 200 meters before the turnoff. This behavior could reduce lane changes and last-minute slowdowns.

news.title: Tesla’s Cybercab is now available by invitation
news.description: The Cybercab has been announced as available by invitation.

news.title: Speaker considers Tesla’s future model insufficiently desirable
news.description: One participant believes wealthy people would not want to be seen in this plastic vehicle and instead cites the Roadster as an attractive model, if it ever materializes.

news.title: An owner uses public NEMA 14-50 outlets to charge their Tesla
news.description: After buying their first Tesla in 2023, an owner discovered NEMA 14-50 outlets in a public park they visited daily. The outlets had originally been installed for food trucks.

news.title: Owner requests a light in the Tesla charging port
news.description: An owner would like a light in the charging port to make it easier to position the connector when it is raining, without having to find the opening by touch.

news.title: Tesla could insure autonomous vehicles itself
news.description: Tesla has long considered becoming the insurer of fully autonomous vehicles, while potentially partnering with existing insurance companies in heavily regulated markets.

news.title: A buyer receives a new Tesla with outdated software
news.description: An owner of a Model Y 2027 says they asked whether the software was up to date at delivery and received an affirmative answer. Their one-month FSD trial began immediately afterward.

news.title: Forum member defends electric vehicles against hybrids
news.description: One participant says they would not choose any hybrid for a road trip over their Model 3 Performance or Cybertruck. They say they have been taking fully electric trips for a long time.

news.title: User reminds others that FSD must be actively supervised
news.description: A user says they would only feel unsafe with FSD if they were not actively supervising it. To them, that means staying attentive to the road and keeping their hands ready to take control.

news.title: Thinking Machines Launches Inkling 2 Mini, a Model That Runs on Mac
news.description: Inkling 2 Mini is a general-purpose multimodal model compact enough to run on a Mac with at least 32 GB of RAM. It uses, among other things, a new looped transformer architecture and joins the small number of American open-weight models competing with China’s lead.

news.title: Create a 60-second KPI recap video with Claude
news.description: The tutorial explains how to connect a data source in Claude, create a “Visual short” artifact and generate a summary video for management. It recommends checking indicator definitions, filters and periods before approving the result.

news.title: Notion recommends a shared context system to automate work
news.description: Notion co-founder Akshay Kothari advises organizations to create a shared space containing their information and processes. He says this “context system” would allow agents to learn continuously and take over routine tasks, while employees supervise their work.

news.title: AI demand threatens to cause a printed circuit board shortage
news.description: Demand for AI servers is straining the supply of printed circuit boards and displacing automotive, medical and industrial orders. A significant improvement in supply is not expected before mid-2028.

news.title: Ubuntu targets 2028 for its immutable desktop
news.description: Canonical is targeting Ubuntu 28.04 LTS for Core Desktop, with the provisional goal of making it the default download in version 30.04. The system is based on isolated snap packages and atomic updates, while traditional Ubuntu will remain available.

news.title: SAP details its strategy for an autonomous enterprise
news.description: SAP’s AI chief explains how the company manages costs, governance and models for its autonomous enterprise concept and AI agents. SAP combines daily usage limits, default models and centralized controls, but still struggles to link token consumption directly to financial value.

news.title: Cloud monitoring can miss AI failures
news.description: An AI service can remain online while producing incorrect answers, violating policies or generating unexpected costs. Teams must monitor output quality, agent behavior and spending, and establish processes for restoring reliable behavior.

news.title: Google rolls out ambient networking for GKE
news.description: Google announced general availability of ambient networking for Google Kubernetes Engine, with a sidecarless service mesh architecture. It separates networking functions from application workloads to reduce resource consumption and management complexity.

news.title: AWS tests centralized Internet firewall controls
news.description: AWS Network Firewall can now apply centralized filtering rules directly to VPC Internet gateways without changing routing or architecture. The preview includes built-in NAT and automatically extends policies to new VPCs and subnets.

news.title: GitHub releases Enterprise Server 3.23 release candidate
news.description: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23 adds improved filtering in GitHub Projects, AI secret detection in isolated environments and expanded malware detection. The update also brings several improvements to Dependabot, OAuth tokens and cluster configuration.

news.title: AWS adds an API to instantly estimate workload costs
news.description: The new Pricing Calculator API estimates up to 500 usage lines per request based on public or customer-specific rates. It allows infrastructure price calculations to be integrated directly into existing tools.

news.title: AWS DevOps Agent expands its conversational capabilities
news.description: AWS DevOps Agent can now directly execute GitHub and PagerDuty actions from Claude Code, Slack and Microsoft Teams.

news.title: Windows hotpatch causes application failures
news.description: Microsoft acknowledged application failures after the November hotpatch for Windows 11 and provided a Registry workaround that requires a restart.
